_comment: Reusable IAM policy templates for an AWS data science project, grounded in the course's own Riverbend Meals churn project (Lesson 5: IAM for Data Science Work). Replace the account ID, bucket name, and role name placeholders before use. These are illustrative templates for study, not a substitute for testing in a real account.

scoped_s3_access_for_churn_project._comment: Attach alongside AmazonSageMakerFullAccess, which only covers buckets with 'sagemaker'/'aws-glue' in the name. This statement grants exactly what the Riverbend Meals project needs: read-only raw data, read-write processed and models prefixes.

scoped_pass_role_for_training_jobs._comment: Lets a data scientist's own IAM identity hand the execution role to SageMaker when starting a training job, without being able to pass any other role in the account.

glue_job_execution_role_trust_policy._comment: For a Glue ETL job that promotes a pandas feature-prep script (Lesson 2) to scale.

redshift_unload_role_trust_policy._comment: For the IAM_ROLE a Redshift UNLOAD statement assumes to write Parquet to S3 (Lesson 4).
